title: A flood of submissions from one source is refused
description:
**Phase 1 of 5.**

- **Blocked by:** the no-principal route story
- **Runs in parallel with:** the rest of this epic
- **Unblocks:** nothing

---
The route takes unauthenticated writes from the open internet, behind the CloudFront invoke secret but in front of nothing else. Rate limiting is the only thing standing between the operator queue and someone with a loop.

**Done when:** the scenario exists and fails for the right reason.

comments.text:
Feature: Public waitlist submission

  Scenario: Repeated submissions from one source are refused
    Given a source that has submitted the waitlist survey at the allowed limit
    When that source submits the survey again
    Then the response is 429
    And no additional waitlist signup is recorded
